risk_description: Participants may shape language but not actual problem definition if institutional frame is fixed
Worker participation may reveal hidden labor but lead to efficiency changes that increase workload
Excluded groups may share barriers without receiving feedback or benefit
Workshops may still exclude disabled participants if access support is incomplete
Design team may retain final interpretation despite participant review
Participants may be asked to evaluate AI systems without accessible explanation of model behavior
Institutional actors may dominate governance and weaken participant influence
Community members may be asked for feedback repeatedly without visible implementation
Caregiver participation may reveal unpaid labor without changing service burden
Participant data and design contributions may be stored or reused beyond agreed purposes
